{
  "name": "ev-side-by-side",
  "version": "1.0.0",
  "private": true,
  "packageManager": "pnpm@11.19.0",
  "scripts": {
    "dev": "next dev --hostname 127.0.0.1",
    "build": "pnpm validate && next build && pnpm build:portable",
    "start": "next start --hostname 127.0.0.1",
    "typecheck": "tsc --noEmit",
    "lint": "eslint src tests scripts",
    "test": "node --import tsx --test --test-concurrency=2 tests/*.test.ts",
    "validate": "node --import tsx scripts/validate.ts",
    "audit:content": "node --import tsx scripts/audit-completeness.ts",
    "test:e2e": "playwright test",
    "format": "prettier --write src tests scripts",
    "build:portable": "node --import tsx scripts/build-portable.ts",
    "build:art": "node --import tsx scripts/build-chapter-art.ts",
    "build:public": "pnpm validate && node scripts/build-public.mjs",
    "preview:review": "node --import tsx scripts/serve-roadmark.ts"
  },
  "dependencies": {
    "next": "16.3.8",
    "react": "19.3.0",
    "react-dom": "19.3.0"
  },
  "devDependencies": {
    "@axe-core/playwright": "^4.10.0",
    "@playwright/test": "^1.58.0",
    "@types/node": "^24.0.0",
    "@types/react": "^19.0.0",
    "@types/react-dom": "^19.0.0",
    "esbuild": "0.28.2",
    "eslint": "^9.0.0",
    "eslint-config-next": "16.3.8",
    "lighthouse": "^13.5.0",
    "prettier": "^3.9.9",
    "tsx": "^4.20.0",
    "typescript": "^5.9.3"
  },
  "engines": {
    "node": ">=22"
  }
}
